Definition: from πέρνημι (to sell; akin to the base of G4097); a (male) prostitute (as venal), i.e. (by analogy) a debauchee (libertine):--fornicator, whoremonger.
BiblicalUsage: Pornos is the male fornicator, the whoremonger, and Paul puts him outside the kingdom. He tells the Corinthians not to keep company with fornicators, and says no whoremonger has any inheritance in the kingdom of Christ and of God. Hebrews holds up Esau as the warning, a profane person who sold his birthright for a meal.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Esau is the picture here: a moment's appetite traded for a lifetime's inheritance. God forgives the fornicator who repents, but he never calls the sin small.
